en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style image of a large institutional building with steep, tiled, hipped roofs and dormer windows, reminiscent of early 20th‑century Central European architecture. The complex surrounds a central, turreted entrance pavilion over a pedestrian gate set in a solid plastered wall with wooden picket fencing. A weather vane tops the central roof tower. The street in front appears cobbled, and the overall view is a formal architectural photograph taken from across the road.
